(DCIL) is a [[Hong Kong]]–based luxury goods company. The company is controlled by its founder and Executive Chairman [[Dickson Poon]] ({{lang|zh-hant|潘廸生}}). == History == The company Dickson Concepts was founded by [[Dickson Poon]]. In 1991, the company acquired [[Harvey Nichols]] from the Burton Group.{{cite news|url=https://wwd.com/feature/article-1119481-1779393/|title=Harvey Nichols: Dickson's Triumph: Dicksons Concepts used tough tactics to make Harvey Nichols a success|date=16 September 1997|newspaper=Women's Wear Daily|access-date=20 August 2023}} In January 2005, the company announced the acquisition of Bertolucci SA, manufacturer and distributor of luxury Swiss watches.[https://www.dickson.com.hk/doc/pressrelease/Bertolucci%20%20-e%20(19.1.05).pdf Press release], DCIL, 19 January 2005 In mid-February 2009, the company announced the end of its 20-plus year distributorship for [[Polo Ralph Lauren]] products in Asia effective 31 December 2009. The license is estimated by analysts to contribute 10 percent of its revenues.Benjamin Scent, [http://www.thestandard.com.hk/news_detail.asp?pp_cat=30&art_id=78339&sid=22736828&con_type=1&d_str=20090217&sear_year=2009 Dickson may lose its shirt as top brands go it alone], The Standard, 17 February 2009 ==Ownership== As of 30 September 2018, Dickson Poon controls 54.68% of the voting capital of DCIL through two trusts.{{Cite web| title=Dickson concepts (international) limited - Interim Report 2018-2019 | url=https://www.dickson.com.hk/doc/2018F/EIR131218.pdf | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190506094121/https://www.dickson.com.hk/doc/2018F/EIR131218.pdf | archive-date=2019-05-06}} == References == {{Reflist}} == External links == *[https://www.dickson.com.hk Official site] * {{Finance links | symbol = 0113 | google = HKG:+0113 | yahoo = 0113.HK | bloomberg = 0113:HK | reuters = 0113.HK }} [[Category:Companies listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange]] [[Category:Retail companies of Hong Kong]] [[Category:Offshore companies of Bermuda]] [[Category:Companies in the Hang Seng Index]] [[Category:Conglomerate companies of Hong Kong]]
